title: Gaming in their golden years: why millions of seniors are playing video

sentences: Michelle Statham's preferred game is Call of Duty, a fast, frenetic military shooter inspired by real history.
She typically spends six hours a day livestreaming to Twitch from her home in Washington state, chatting to her more than 110,000 followers.
She boasts about how she'll beat opponents and trash-talks as she races across rooftops to avoid enemy fire.
When she's hit, she "respawns" at a checkpoint and jumps right back into the fray.
translations: 米歇尔·斯塔瑟姆最喜欢的游戏是《使命召唤》，这是一款受真实历史启发、节奏快速且激烈的军事射击游戏。
她通常每天花六小时在华盛顿州的家中向Twitch直播，与超过11万名粉丝聊天。
她一边夸耀自己将如何击败对手，一边说着挑衅的话，同时快速穿越屋顶以躲避敌人的火力。
当她被击中时，她会在检查点“重生”，并立即重新投入战斗。

sentences: The military shooter game has a predominantly young male user base, but Statham's Twitch handle is TacticalGramma — a nod to the 60-year-old's two grandkids.
Her lifelong gaming hobby has become an income stream, as well as a way to have fun, stay sharp and connect socially.
"A lot of people are surprised that someone my age is playing video games," Statham admits.
She finds the gameplay exhilarating, particularly landing long sniper shots or taking down enemies midair.
translations: 这款军事射击游戏的主要用户群体是年轻男性，但Statham的Twitch账号名为TacticalGramma——这是对她60岁身份和两个孙辈的呼应。
她毕生的游戏爱好已成为一项收入来源，同时也是娱乐、保持敏锐和社交联络的方式。
“很多人惊讶于我这般年纪的人还在玩电子游戏，”Statham坦言道。
她认为游戏过程令人兴奋，尤其是完成远距离狙击或空中击倒敌人时。

sentences: Statham juggles in-game multitasking with live-chatting to her multigenerational audience.
Younger followers have taught her slang, while she keeps gaming from displacing physical activity by exercising daily, often going to the gym with her daughter.
translations: 斯塔瑟姆在游戏内多任务处理与面向多代观众的实时聊天之间灵活切换。
年轻粉丝教她俚语，同时她通过每天锻炼（经常和女儿一起去健身房）来防止游戏取代体育活动。

sentences: Statham is one of the 57 million Americans over 50 who game, a group representing 28% of roughly 205 million total US gamers, according to recent data from the Entertainment Software Association.
Nearly half of Americans in their 60s and 70s play some form of video game every week, as do more than a third of people in their 80s.
As more gamers age, older adults are becoming increasingly visible in the gaming mainstream.
translations: 根据娱乐软件协会的最新数据，斯塔瑟姆是美国5700万50岁以上游戏玩家中的一员，这一群体约占美国2.05亿游戏玩家总数的28%。
近半数的六七十岁美国人每周都会玩某种形式的电子游戏，而八十多岁的人群中也有超过三分之一的人如此。
随着越来越多的游戏玩家变老，老年人在游戏主流中变得越来越显眼。

sentences: "Age is like having a sign around your neck saying: 'I'm old and I can't do this,'" says Will, a 72-year-old retired navy veteran from Missouri who streams games to 1.4 million YouTube subscribers under the username GrndpaGaming.
"That's not the case with me and other older gamers out there," he says.
"Someone my age can keep up with technology."
translations: "年龄就像脖子上挂着一个牌子，上面写着：'我老了，做不了这个了，'"来自密苏里州的72岁退休海军老兵威尔说道，他以GrndpaGaming的用户名向140万YouTube订阅者直播游戏。
"但我和其他年长玩家并非如此，"他说道。
"像我这样年纪的人也能跟上技术发展。"

sentences: Some research suggests older adults may benefit from gaming, though the effects vary by game type.
There are games designed to boost memory and attention, as well as puzzle games that require players to remember patterns, sequences and spatial layouts.
Such games have been shown to help players of any age improve visual memory and cognitive processing.
Fitness games that incorporate physical movement may also improve balance and coordination.
translations: 一些研究表明，老年人可能从游戏中受益，尽管效果因游戏类型而异。
有些游戏旨在增强记忆力和注意力，还有需要玩家记住图案、顺序和空间布局的益智游戏。
这类游戏已被证明能帮助任何年龄的玩家改善视觉记忆和认知处理能力。
融入身体运动的健身游戏也可能改善平衡和协调能力。

sentences: Dr Gregory West, an associate professor of psychology at the University of Montreal, studied gamers of all ages in 2018.

He found that participants who spent hours playing first-person shooters experienced a reduction in grey matter in the hippocampal region of the brain, while those who played games involving exploration of 3D open worlds showed improvement in the same area.
Reduced hippocampal volume is associated with a higher risk of neuropsychiatric illness, West explains.
translations: 蒙特利尔大学心理学副教授格雷戈里·韦斯特博士在2018年研究了各个年龄段的游戏玩家。
他发现，花费数小时玩第一人称射击游戏的参与者大脑海马区的灰质减少，而玩涉及探索3D开放世界游戏的参与者同一区域则有所改善。
韦斯特解释说，海马体体积缩小与神经精神疾病风险增加有关。

sentences: However, West cautions against drawing simple conclusions.
His study did not focus specifically on older adults, and he notes that seniors who succeed in competitive gaming likely start with strong cognitive abilities.
Multiplayer games can also provide social benefits.
"Older adults, through playing video games online with other people and communicating through microphones, are receiving real social stimulation," he says.
translations: 然而，韦斯特警告不要得出简单的结论。
他的研究并未专门针对老年人，并指出在竞技游戏中表现出色的老年人很可能一开始就拥有较强的认知能力。
多人游戏还能带来社交益处。
他说：“老年人通过与他人一起在线玩电子游戏并通过麦克风交流，正在获得真实的社交刺激。”

sentences: "As long as you keep your brain active and functioning, you're not going to just deteriorate away," says Will.
Even amid combat games, the social interactions can be surprisingly warm.
"People always say: 'I love you, Gramps. Keep on doing what you're doing,'" he says.
translations: "只要保持大脑活跃和正常运转，你就不会轻易衰退，"威尔说道。
即使在战斗游戏中，社交互动也可能出人意料地温暖。
"人们总是说：'我爱你，老爷爷。继续做你正在做的事吧，'"他说道。

sentences: Gaming can also help people manage a variety of ailments, says Dr Kris Alexander, an associate professor of media production at Toronto Metropolitan University who helped launch GameRx.
Studies suggest that playing Tetris shortly after a traumatic experience may reduce PTSD symptoms, while virtual reality environments can help lessen pain for burn victims.
Alexander believes gaming has clear potential benefits for seniors, though physical challenges like joint pain and declining vision can pose barriers.
translations: 多伦多城市大学媒体制作副教授、曾参与推出GameRx的克里斯·亚历山大博士表示，游戏还能帮助人们应对多种疾病。
研究表明，在经历创伤后不久玩俄罗斯方块可能减轻创伤后应激障碍症状，而虚拟现实环境则有助于减轻烧伤患者的疼痛。
亚历山大认为，游戏对老年人具有明显的潜在益处，尽管关节疼痛和视力下降等身体挑战可能构成障碍。

sentences: As the senior gaming population grows, so may demand for accessibility tools.
Will, who required surgery in 2010 that left him with limited mobility, now uses an adaptive gaming keypad that allows him to position keys comfortably.
Other tools — including voice controls, foot pedals and custom controller modifications — are making gaming more accessible.
translations: 随着老年游戏玩家群体的增长，对无障碍工具的需求也可能随之增加。
威尔在2010年因手术导致行动受限，如今他使用一种自适应游戏键盘，可以舒适地调整按键位置。
其他工具——包括语音控制、脚踏板和定制控制器改装——正让游戏变得更加无障碍。

sentences: Will hopes his visibility will inspire others.
"If I can do it at my age with this handicap, you can, too," he says.
After all, you're never too old to respawn.
translations: 威尔希望自己的曝光能激励他人。
“如果我在这个年纪带着这样的残疾都能做到，你也可以，”他说道。
毕竟，活到老，重生到老。
